subject: Exercise's hidden signal: how ROS orchestrate whole-body resilience
script: From Agewell Brief: Exercise's hidden signal: how ROS orchestrate whole-body resilience. New review maps the precise redox choreography behind exercise benefits, revealing how muscle-generated oxidants travel via extracellular vesicles to fortify distant tissues—and why aging scrambles the signal. Exercise-induced ROS act as signaling molecules, not just damage agents. Read the full source-linked dispatch and primary study caveats at AgewellBrief.com.
